description: Over r-sort-3c-accdb, read-only: a table-type walk of T in IX_K order from MoveFirst to EOF reading ID; then for every value, Seek "=" on IX_K with its exact code units, reading NoMatch and ID. Gives ACE's order and equality classes of the designed values.
